🚨 @LamorneMorris  came through to promote his new show 'Spider-Noir' on PRIME, and he dives into how his successful role as Winston Bishop on 'New Girl' took his career to new heights. Check out the full interview on @netflix

Video

Looks like friendships on this season of RHOA 🍑 are being tested after Porsha made comments about oysters, which K. Michelle believes were targeted shots at her 👀 . K. Michelle opens up about conversations she caught wind of regarding an alleged plot against her since joining the show, and the girls (Porsha and K. Michelle) have been going at it on Twitter! Tap into the full latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

🚨 'ICEMAN' has been outside since Friday, and on the intro track, Drake opens up about his father battling cancer 💔 TMZ later ran a headline that made it seem like Drake’s dad did not have cancer, but his father has since cleared the air, explaining that he is now cancer-free. 🙏🏽 The Breakfast Club weighs in on the album, tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

🚨 Not only are the fans are speaking out on Drakes new album and the shots he’s taken, so are the people mentioned . DJ Khaled responds to Drake’s diss and @lorenlorosa has the latest!

Video

🚨 Not Tyrese thinking @COMEDIANSKEET  isn’t funny 😆. Skeet looks back on a time when Tyrese called him out at a celebrity-studded dinner.

Video

🚨 @theonlyjasonlee explains the differences being a politician versus an entertainment mogul. Each role comes with different hardships depending on which hat he wears. Jason opens up about why politics has been harder than being a public figure. Tap into the full conversation on @netflix

Video

Comedian @COMEDIANSKEET  opens up about how Kevin Hart supported his career early on, and how Michael Blackson kicked him off his comedy tour because he wasn’t ugly enough 😅. Tap into the full conversation on @netflix.

Video

🚨 An old clip of a 19 year old @theonlyjasonlee on the Ricki Lake Show  resurfaced👀 In the throwback clip, Jason  appears on the show with a girlfriend back when he was a straight man, and Jason gives unbothered as the clip making rounds again. 🎙️Tap into the full conversation on @netflix

🚨 @kiergaines breaks down why cultural competence in therapy matters and how it can directly impact the way people receive treatment. He also explains how certain licensing and testing standards may negatively affect Black test takers pursuing careers in therapy. 🧠🎙️
Tap into the full conversation on @netflix

Video

Donkey of the Day goes to a couple who were arrested after locking their 11-year-old daughter in the garage to “teach her how to be homeless.” This isn’t punishment — this is abuse!
Tap into #DOTD, powered by @msllegal 🐂 #MichaelTheBull #TheBullNYC

Video

Well, Drake’s song '1 AM in Albany' allegedly leaked, and you can hear him taking shots at Kendrick, Dr. Dre, and more! The Breakfast Club weighs in, tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa.

Video

🚨📲 Instagram has rolled out a new feature called “Instants” that can now be found in your DMs! Think IG Stories, but more spontaneous 👀

The feature lets you share, unfiltered photos that disappear after 24 hours and are only visible to your friends. Want to try it out? Head to your DMs, tap the icon in the bottom-right corner of your screen, and start sharing 📸🔥 Tap into Front Page News 📰 w/ @mimibrowntv

Video

In an interview, Nicki Minaj explained how she was always, deep down, a Trump supporter and how she feels the music industry influences people to become Democrats. She also speaks on losing trust in Obama and Gov. Newsom. Tap into the latest w/ @lorenlorosa

Video

🚨 How important is it to be a 'licensed' therapist? Kier Gaines breaks down why proper training matters in the world of therapy and explains how being a licensed clinician helps professionals provide real, solution-based guidance while following ethical standards and practices. 🧠🎙️Tap into the full conversation on @netflix
